title: BetterLimay Record Provenance
description: A fact must be auditable: another maintainer has to be able to go back to the source and check it. A public URL is the easiest way to allow that, but it is not the only one. An official document held by the maintainers is equally auditable when it is cited precisely enough to be requested or located again — publisher, exact title, issue date and page. Exactly one of source_url or source_document is required.

source_document.description: Exact title of the document, as printed on it.

source_issued.description: Date the document was issued or published, if stated.

source_page.description: Page the specific fact appears on, as printed in the document.
